items.q: Do I need a card machine?
items.a: No. The till takes cash and shows PromptPay codes. If you also accept cards, you take them on your own card machine and press Card on the till to record the sale.

items.q: What if the internet goes down?
items.a: Keep selling. The till saves every sale on the device and sends it to your account when the connection returns.

items.q: Can my staff change the prices?
items.a: Not if you set a manager PIN. They can still sell, keep bills for later and print receipts.

items.q: What if I lose my phone?
items.a: Your sales and menu are saved in your account. Sign in on another device with a link we email you.

items.q: Is the receipt a tax invoice?
items.a: The till prints a receipt with your shop name, address, tax ID and VAT. Check with your accountant whether you need anything more.
